messages:
ellie_finance: flagging an anomaly — customer 'polaris' has a ~3x jump in billable embed units concentrated around 2026-12-08T12:00Z. looks like duplicate aggregation rather than real traffic. can ops investigate? :mag:
raj_platform: thanks for the ping. do you have a sample request_id or export rows we can look at?
sam_eng: i pulled a quick slice from billing_raw: ```2026-12-08T12:03:14Z req=q9xpolaris embed_units=10
2026-12-08T12:03:14Z req=q9xpolaris embed_units=10  <-- duplicate
```
ellie_finance: exact. invoice line shows +98,700 duplicated embed units for that hour.
ops-bot: ALERT: batch-ingest v2.5 deployed at 2026-12-08T11:47Z with feature toggle `emit_also_windowed=true`.
raj_platform: that toggle was intended to emit windowed totals only to internal metrics, not to billing. looks like the toggle accidentally routed to the billing topic too. if the aggregator receives both per-request and windowed totals, it could double-count.
morgan_billing: confirmed aggregator expects only per-request events; windowed totals create synthetic rows with same request_id + window_tag. dedupe key is request_id alone, but windowed rows include a suffix in request_id currently removed by a post-process — which failed in this deploy.
sam_eng: root cause: string trimming function `normalize_request_id()` regressed in the v2.5 jar; it no longer strips `:window` suffix. i can patch and roll a hotfix.
raj_platform: mitigation options: (A) emergency backfill/dedupe job to collapse duplicates by request_id for 12:00-13:00 UTC (produces audited delta CSV), (B) manual credit on invoices while we validate ledger changes. ops prefers (A) if risk is acceptable because it preserves audit trail.
ellie_finance: finance prefers ledger adjustment but will accept credit if the backfill risks corrupting joins. we need size and ETA of the delta CSV.
morgan_billing: estimate: candidate delta rows ~24,675, compressed ~1.3MB, embed_unit delta ~98,700. dry-run dedupe will take ~60 minutes; full ledger apply ~2-3 hours with supervision. will need head-of-billing sign-off.
sam_eng: patching normalize_request_id now and will run canary. if canary looks good i will produce the delta CSV and checksums.
ops-bot: NOTE: dry-run job queued (job_id=dr-2181234567-01). snapshot size ~50MB.
ellie_finance: please @mention me when CSV is ready. finance will prepare a short customer communication explaining the duplicate-count correction and estimated invoice adjustment. we prefer ledger apply for auditability. thanks. :white_check_mark:
